notes.title: You can throw cats... starting TOMORROW!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
notes.notes:
Hello, Cat Loving Friends!

Tomorrow is the big day!  Get those cat throwing arms warmed up!
Remember, Orange Kitties in the Orange bins, Yellow Kitties in the Yellow bins... etc.
Have an idea for a sweet mod or fun update?  Throw your ideas on the community page.

Happy tossin'!
